summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking in the street when they see the Silver Detective having helped an old lady find her cat. Just as when the two groups of detectives are having a conversation after not seeing each other for a long time, a woman passing by the street hears the Silver Detective introducing themselves as detectives, and decides to ask them to find her missing husband. Victim: Shinsuke Sugamo Time: Half a month ago He went out his house to find a job, but has not returned since. The woman is Machiko Sugamo. Three months ago, the company Shinsuke Sugamo worked in went down, and he had to find a job. However, one morning around half a month ago, Sugamo went out to find a job opportunity, and hadn’t returned since. His whereabouts are unclear while his communication is also unavailable. Both detective groups reassure her that they will soon find him. Conan suggests two possibilities: Either the husband chose to disappear for some reason or he got caught up into something bad. The Silver Detectives volunteer to investigate the latter route while Conan and the Detective Boys will investigate the former route, and Haibara will look after the elderly so they won’t mess up the scene like last time. After a while, the Silver Detectives find a useful clue: A man working at Cheetah Delivery saw Shinsuke arguing with Tadao Yuge exactly three months ago, as the latter insisted on not selling his home, and even pushed Sugamo away. Coincidentally, after Haibara's efforts to stop the three elderly from acting recklessly to prove Tadao is guilty fail miserably as they go in and dig his yard, they find the skeleton of a person with a broken rib. A skeleton discovered by Mutsuhiko Akasaka and Ginta Oshima Shinsuke Sugamo with Conan and the Detective Boys Takagi, Megure, and Chiba arrive at the scene with some other officers. Haibara suggests that the person buried in this yard must have been killed. One problem is that could a body dissolve that fast in just half a month? Machiko also arrives at the yard to see if the skeleton belongs to her husband or not. Suddenly, Shinsuke appears with Conan and the Detective Boys. It turns out that he failed to find a job and felt guilty to his wife, to the point where he became very depressed and couldn’t figure out the timing to return. For the time he'd been missing, he had stayed at a friend’s place. The police bring Tadao to the interrogation room, but soon release him due to the fact that those bones are at least 300 years old, and Tadao couldn’t kill someone at Edo time. This report makes the Silver Detective very depressed, as according to them, he had signs that prove he is not entirely innocent. Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys decide to investigate Tadao’s acquaintances: Shinsuke recalls that Tadao insisted on not selling the home because he wanted to keep his memories of his deceased wife, and wanted the son who ran away to have a place to return to. Sugamo targeted the house since he heard that Tadao was planning to move to the countryside and live quietly, but gave up the intention after what happened to him. Shigeko Noda, a neighbor, recounts the events that had happened to Tadao’s family: Four years ago, his son Tatsuya messed things up at work. He resigned from the job and had been very depressed about his self-worth since. Then one day, he disappeared and left no communication to his family while Tadao reassured his wife that their son would be back stronger. However, Tadao’s wife passed away when she was talking with Noda about her son’s whereabouts being unclear for the past year.
